data.caption: Customs Value against Duty Forgone, shown to answer relationship between declared customs value and the duty forgone amount. The national customs administration maintains this registry of monthly preferential tariff filings to monitor revenue forgone under free trade agreements, evaluate origin certification compliance across tariff headings, and track claims through clearance and audit stages.
